formulas.formula: See how extra payments shave years and interest off your home loan.
Mortgage: home price, down payment, rate, years and first payment date. The payment fills itself in.
Mortgage: add taxes, insurance, PMI and HOA for your full monthly cost.
Mortgage: add an extra amount every month and/or once a year (bonus or tax refund month).
Schedule: all 360 months. Type one-time extras in the Extra column and tick Paid as you go.
Dashboard: payoff date, interest and years saved, equity and when PMI ends.
What If: pick a payoff date, or see what $50 to $1,000 extra a month would do.
Tell your lender extra money goes to principal.
Drops off here when the balance reaches 78% of the home price.
Half a payment every 2 weeks = 13 payments a year. See What If.
Red means something needs a look.

=IF('Mortgage'!$R$4<=0,"Start on the Mortgage tab.",IF(R9=9999,"Paid off. The house is yours!","Next payment: "&TEXT(EDATE('Mortgage'!$R$7,R9-1),"mmm d, yyyy")&"  |  P&I + extra "&TEXT(INDEX('Schedule'!$G$6:$G$365,R9),"$#,##0.00")))

=IF(R4<=0,"Type your home price and down payment (or loan amount) to start.",IF(AND(R9>0,R9<=ROUND(R4*R5,2)),"Your payment does not cover the interest. Raise it.",IF(AND(R11>0,R12=0),"Pick a month for the yearly extra.","All set. Check the Dashboard.")))
Tick Paid each month. Type one-time extras in column D.
Each calendar year of the mortgage.
